title: FileVault is enabled
description: Observe an unambiguous FileVault On or Off status. Encryption transitions and unknown output require review.
remediation: With authorization, review FileVault in System Settings, confirm recovery-key escrow, and enable disk encryption according to organizational policy.

title: Application Firewall is enabled
description: Read the native Application Firewall global status. This does not evaluate individual application rules or packet-filter configuration.
remediation: Review required network access and enable the macOS Application Firewall through an approved configuration process.

title: System Integrity Protection is fully enabled
description: Accept only the standard enabled status. Custom configurations, unsupported output, and uncertain protection states are ERROR.
remediation: Review any SIP exception with the system owner. Restore the approved full SIP configuration using Apple's documented recovery workflow when appropriate.

title: Gatekeeper assessments are enabled
description: Read the native assessment subsystem status; this does not verify every application or replace malware detection. Unsupported command behavior is ERROR.
remediation: Review application security settings and restore the organization's approved Gatekeeper assessment policy through supported Apple administration tools.

title: Automatic update checking preference is enabled
description: Read the explicit machine SoftwareUpdate AutomaticCheckEnabled preference. An absent key is unknown; effective MDM policy and update availability are not verified.
remediation: Review the effective software update policy with the device administrator and explicitly configure automatic update checking through an approved method.

title: Automatic update download preference is enabled
description: Read the explicit machine SoftwareUpdate AutomaticDownload preference. This does not establish that downloads or installation currently succeed or prove effective MDM policy.
remediation: Review update management and explicitly enable automatic update downloads using the organization's approved policy mechanism.

title: Critical update installation preference is enabled
description: Read the explicit machine SoftwareUpdate CriticalUpdateInstall preference. This is not proof that all security updates are installed or that an MDM policy is effective.
remediation: Review automatic security update settings and explicitly enable the critical update installation preference through approved device management.

title: System data update installation preference is enabled
description: Read the explicit machine SoftwareUpdate ConfigDataInstall preference. This does not establish current XProtect versions, malware protection status, or effective MDM policy.
remediation: Review system data and security response update policy, and explicitly enable supported automatic system data updates through approved management.

title: Remote Login is disabled
description: Read systemsetup Remote Login status. The command may require administrative privileges; permission failures are ERROR. Approved remote administration may require an exception.
remediation: Review the need for SSH access with the system owner. Disable Remote Login when unnecessary or document an approved, restricted remote administration exception.

title: Current-user screen saver password preference is enabled
description: Read only the invoking user's explicit com.apple.screensaver askForPassword preference. This does not verify effective runtime locking, ByHost overrides, MDM policy, other users, or a screen saver timeout.
remediation: Review the invoking user's effective lock settings and managed policy. Require authentication after sleep or screen saver using the organization's approved configuration.

title: Current-user screen saver password delay preference is zero
description: Read only the invoking user's explicit askForPasswordDelay scalar. Zero expresses an immediate-password preference; it does not prove password enforcement or effective runtime/ByHost/MDM policy.
remediation: Review effective lock enforcement and configure immediate authentication after sleep or screen saver under approved user or managed policy.

title: Network time configuration is enabled
description: Read systemsetup network-time configuration. This does not prove successful synchronization or server accuracy. Administrative privilege may be required; unavailable output is ERROR.
remediation: Review the approved network time source and enable automatic time configuration through supported system settings or device management.
